extracted.name: Aunt Kaye's Rhubarb Dump Cake
extracted.description: This rhubarb dump cake is an easy dessert to make with 5 ingredients including rhubarb, strawberry gelatin, and cake mix for a delicious sweet treat.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound rhubarb, cut into 1/4 inch slices
1 (3 ounce) package strawberry flavored Jell-O® mix
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Spread rhubarb evenly in the bottom of the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle sugar over rhubarb, followed by gelatin mix, and finally cake mix. Pour water and melted butter over the top. Do not stir.
Bake in the preheated oven until rhubarb is tender, about 45 minutes.
